name: antigravity-telegram-bridge
description: Zero-cost Telegram bot bridge for Antigravity CLI and Claude Code over CGNAT

scripts.daemon:check: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$e=$null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Resolve-Path 'daemon.ps1').Path,[ref]$null,[ref]$e); if($e){$e|ForEach-Object{Write-Host ('L'+$_.Extent.StartLineNumber+': '+$_.Message)}; exit 1} else {Write-Host 'daemon.ps1: parse OK'}"

author: KZvilla
